commitMessage: Track Gett, Wonderful and AITAN product roles (Oct 29)

jobUpserts.location: Tel Aviv, Israel; hybrid reported by Built In (other boards say on-site; verify)
jobUpserts.next: Consider: confirm scaled iOS/Android B2C ownership requirement and hybrid policy before applying
jobUpserts.note: Consider (86). B2C and B2B product ownership, full discovery-to-launch cycle, mobile journeys, GA4/Firebase analytics, conversion/retention, APIs and hands-on AI prototyping. Gaps: no verified scaled native iOS/Android product launches or Mixpanel/agentic personalization in production. Work model conflicts across boards.

jobUpserts.role: Technical Program Manager – Deployment Tooling (Technical Product Manager remit)
jobUpserts.next: Consider: clarify mandatory developer-tools/FDE experience and five-day on-site requirement
jobUpserts.note: Consider (82). Product roadmap, discovery, internal workflow automation, integrations, engineering collaboration, productization of field needs and hands-on AI prototyping. Gaps: no verified developer tooling/FDE ownership, PR/code/log reviews, or production agent evaluation systems; on-site role.

jobUpserts.location: Ramat Gan, Israel; hybrid reported by Alion (verify)
jobUpserts.next: Consider: verify system-level PM requirements, customer/field exposure and current opening (older LinkedIn listing closed)
jobUpserts.note: Consider (80). Roadmap, prioritization, complex technical requirements, R&D and operations coordination, Industrial Engineering and HP Indigo operational experience. Gaps: no drone/flight-control or safety-critical systems PM experience; old LinkedIn version closed, current Comeet role appears open on employer job board.

detail.source: Gett Comeet C2.47D, Jobish 2026-10-28, Built In and Emploive 2026-10-29
detail.summary: Own end-to-end Rider App across iOS and Android; research, user journeys, conversion and retention, AI personalization, product strategy, roadmap and cross-team execution.
detail.requirements: 5+ years product management with proven scaled B2C mobile apps on iOS and Android, full lifecycle, analytics (e.g. Mixpanel), technical and GenAI fluency, Hebrew and English. Mobility marketplace and B2B rider experience advantages.
why: B2C/B2B SaaS experience at CallApp for Business and Tapuhi
Discovery, requirements, engineering/UX collaboration, launch and iteration
GA4/Firebase experience analyzing digital funnels and behavior
APIs, payments and end-to-end digital customer journeys
Hands-on AI tools and Full Stack technical foundation
gaps: No verified track record owning scaled native iOS and Android consumer-app launches
No verified production agentic AI personalization or Mixpanel experience
Work model is inconsistent across public listings: hybrid versus on-site
detail.scoreExplanation: 86%: strong product and mobile user-journey overlap, but scaled native consumer app ownership is a central unverified requirement.

detail.source: Wonderful Ashby 2bcdf568-896d-454a-bbf8-6ce1899eb3bc, AI Hiring Board verified 2026-10-27, Alion checked 2026-10-28
detail.summary: Own product strategy and roadmap for tooling used by deployment engineers to build, test, launch and monitor AI agents; standardize field-built tools and improve deployment quality and adoption.
detail.requirements: 4+ years in technical PM, forward-deployed or solutions engineering, or software engineering; experience building developer tools or internal technical products, ability to code/read PRs and logs, and AI-native prototyping. Agent evals and enterprise deployment are preferred.
why: Approximately five years of end-to-end PM across B2B SaaS and own digital product
Hands-on Full Stack background and Cursor/AI prototyping
Technical requirements, APIs, engineering collaboration and stakeholder coordination
Building new workflows, translating field/customer problems into roadmap
Metrics, delivery and process optimization background
gaps: No verified developer-tools PM, FDE or solutions-engineering product ownership
No verified experience reading production PRs/logs or building AI-agent evaluation infrastructure
On-site Tel Aviv HQ; preferred hybrid/remote work
detail.scoreExplanation: 82%: relevant technical PM and workflow productization, but specific developer tools and production AI deployment expertise are material gaps.

detail.source: AITAN Comeet C7.47C linked by IsraelVC (first seen 2026-10-27; checked 2026-10-28), Alion verified 2026-10-29; older LinkedIn version shows closed
detail.summary: Own product direction, roadmap and integration capabilities for a multi-drone control and flight management platform; translate customer and operational needs into prioritized epics and deliver with R&D and flight-control teams.
detail.requirements: 4+ years Product Manager on complex technical products; analytical prioritization, execution and collaboration with R&D and operations on technical/system-level products; drones and flight control familiarity is an advantage.
why: End-to-end PM requirements, roadmap and prioritization experience
Technical API integration and cross-functional engineering work
HP Indigo experience coordinating production and operational systems
gaps: No verified drone, unmanned systems or flight-control product expertise
No verified ownership of safety-critical multidisciplinary systems
Role previously appeared on LinkedIn as closed; employer Comeet posting needs confirmation
detail.scoreExplanation: 80%: strong core PM and operations foundation, but system-level autonomous drone domain and delivery risks reduce fit.
